properties.Program_Description: Judi's House offers free counseling to grieving children ages 3 to 25 and their adult caregivers.  An initial assessment helps determine the needs of each family member. We offer grief groups as well as individual family couples and play therapy.
properties.Registration_Process: Judi’s House provides support to children and families grieving a death. Services are provided in English and Spanish, to youth ages 3 to 25, and their families at no charge. To inquire about services please call 720.941.0331.

properties.Programs: MBSB(Mind Body Spirit Is Your Business)
properties.Program_Description: Mind Body Spirit is Your Business (MBSB) offers training in Basketball Music Acting Teaching and Coaching. We identify professionals who share their personal stories with you inspire you and move you to train and grow with them.
properties.Registration_Process: After the parent click on the link ""https://mbsbnow.com/session-registration/"" then they will fill out the form. After they fill out the form they will click the submit button then be directed to pay their fee through PayPal. Then they can checkout as a guest by using their PayPal account. If the Parent check out as guest, they still have to enter their email address. Once the parent pay the fee they and me will receive a confirmation email.
